g.text: SMART INDIA HACKATHON 2026 | PS ID: SIH-26034
INSPACK — FIELD OFFICER INSPECTION & COMPLIANCE WORKFLOW
• Authorized Officer Govt ID / SSO login
• Biometric / Cached PIN for remote mandis
• Inspection session initiated with GPS & Time
Inspectors can operate fully without network;
cryptographic session created locally on device.
• Back Panel: Mandatory statutory text & Mfg
• Side Panels: Consumer care, MRP, Dates
• Torch toggle for dimly lit retail shelves
Captures all sides to satisfy Rule 6 requirements
• PASS: Proceeds instantly to AI/OCR pipeline
• FAIL: Haptic alert & instant retake prompt
• Prevents corrupted evidence from reaching engine
• Net Quantity: Numeric value & SI unit symbols
• MRP: Price and "incl. of all taxes" text
• Dates: Month & Year of packing / import / expiry
• Consumer Care: Helpline phone & official email
Powered by sovereign OCR & local edge vision
without transmitting data to commercial clouds.
• Detects packaging text lines and visual blocks
• Computes PDP surface area (cm²) from image
• Measures numeral & font heights in millimeters
• Binds extracted values to 2D bounding boxes
Converts raw packaging pixels into a structured,
coordinate-aware JSON ready for legal rules.
TRANSFER: Structured JSON & Coordinate Map ➔ Legal Rules Engine
• Rule 7 / Tables I-II: Minimum numeral height
• Second Schedule: Standard pack sizes (19 types)
• Rule 18: Statutory MRP format & sticker check
• Inspects bounding boxes on actual commodity
AI never acts as judge; final statutory decision
strictly rests with the authorized human officer.
• Highlights exact infraction zones in Red
• Displays Measured vs. Required statutory values
• Links extracted values to exact legal clauses
Every violation is anchored directly to pixels on
the packaging image with statutory citations.
• Form A: Weight Checking Data Sheet
• Form B: Volume / Length Checking Sheet
Replaces hours of manual form-filling with
• Zero Internet Mode: Stored in IndexedDB
• Local cryptographic storage prevents data loss
• Auto-syncs to Central DB upon connectivity
• High-res image blobs synced to Cloud Vault
Immediate offline local finalization with seamless,
AI assists detection; statutory enforcement authority strictly rests with authorized officer.
Rules are hardcoded from PCR 2011 & Gazette — no probabilistic hallucination in legal decisions.
Zero dependencies on live cellular data in rural markets; auto-syncs securely when connected.
